native_mechanisms: Marks laid on the flat stone in given order, silence held so the order itself is fixed by position before any heap is folded.

Each heap of even count races the musk deer's mountain stride — uphill twist, downhill fold, doubling back — so no heap keeps the shape it entered with, and the running shape is carried forward into the next heap.
The result is searched in squares: the shape turned ninety degrees and its corners folded into its own centre, repeatedly, until one changed mark smears across every square.
The owl seals the final shape to one fixed small size while every intermediate heap is burned, so the token cannot be walked back to its marks.
core_technique: Eight-lane (512-bit) ARX sponge: per-lane xor-rotate-add absorption of 64-byte blocks with distinct per-lane rotation constants, odd lane keys and a block counter, interleaved with hypercube-butterfly quarter-rounds (d=1,2,4) for cross-lane diffusion, finished by a lossy 8-lane collapse plus MurmurHash3 fmix64 — multiplies appear only in the finalizer, not in the mixing core (inputs under 128 bytes take a separate single-accumulator rotate-xor-add path).
